name: gr_triangle_free_compl_edges_lower
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) : Fintype.card V ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Gᶜ.edgeFinset.card + 2 * Fintype.card V
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3), Fintype.card V ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Gᶜ.edgeFinset.card + 2 * Fintype.card V
informal: The complement of a triangle-free graph has at least n(n−2)/4 edges — e(G) + e(Gᶜ) = C(n,2) (SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_compl or a direct count), and Uses Mathlib2.bld_mantel_triangle_free at step 2 for 4e(G) ≤ n²; combine: 4e(Gᶜ) = 2n(n−1) − 4e(G) ≥ n² − 2n.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → Fintype.card V ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Gᶜ.edgeFinset.card + 2 * Fintype.card V
